Package com.cdarobotics.cdalib.bindings

Class BindingManager

java.lang.Object
com.cdarobotics.cdalib.bindings.BindingManager
public class BindingManager extends Object
A registry of named Bindings (boolean conditions) and AnalogBindings (analog inputs). Controls are registered by id and queried by id, decoupling the wiring of an input from the code that reacts to it.

    • addBinding

      public boolean addBinding(String id, BooleanSupplier condition)
      Registers a new Binding under the given id. Does nothing if a binding with that id is already registered.
      Parameters:
      id - the id to register the binding under
      condition - the condition supplier for the binding
      Returns:
      true if the binding was added, false if the id was already taken
